description: Remove someone from the merchant's team — the tool for 'she left', 'take the leaver off'. Takes the userId from get_team ONLY, never a name. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the person: there is no undo from here. If two people share a name, list them and ask which. They stop being able to sign in immediately; their past orders and sales figures are kept, so reports about them still work. You cannot remove the account this agent key belongs to — the server refuses, so that an administrator cannot lock themselves out.

userId.description: User id from get_team — not a name

name: hub_remove_user
title: Remove team member
